note: Recorded by running the landed Python command line as a black box over these invocations, in scratch directories holding synthetic trees built with git under a fixed identity and fixed dates. A step whose standard error carries the argument reader usage text records no standard error text, because the contract states the argument reader texts stand outside the port, and the runner asserts the binary writes its own usage line for such a step. A step the Python command dies on uncaught records the crash and no standard error text, and its expected standing is the refusal the contract states for that failure. The placeholder {ROOT} stands for the root of the tree a case built, {LOG} for the stamped log standing beside it, and {LOGDIR} for a log path inside a folder that does not stand.
